damage.rounding: PE: std::llround = round half away from zero; WK unspecified
damage.note: Attacker's defense and defender's attack are not used in the main hit. Verified against PE CombatSystem.cpp.

defence_bonus.terrain_rules: Forest needs Archery; Mountain needs Climbing; shallow Water and Ocean need Aquatism (all x1.5, owner's tech)
defence_bonus.city_rules: only for the city's OWNER and only units with Fortify; wall adds +2.5 (total 4.0); city bonus replaces terrain bonus if larger; invaders in an enemy city get none; Giant has no Fortify

idle_recovery.v: a unit that neither moved nor attacked heals 2 HP, or 4 HP on tiles of its own city territory

heal_skill.v: Heal action (Mind Bender, Siren): +4 HP to every adjacent friendly; consumes the action; no-op if nobody is hurt

healing.poison_halves_healing_WK: WK only; not seen in PE heal()

veteran.v: 3 kills -> veteran: +5 max HP and full heal; not for StaticSkill units (Giants, boats, special units)
veteran.note: Also granted by ruin 'veteran unit' reward; Warrior vet = 15 HP.

attack_flow.after_moving: only units with Dash may attack after moving; Escape lets a unit move after attacking; Persist lets it attack again after a kill
attack_flow.advance_on_kill: melee (range 1) and Rammer step into the killed unit's tile if legal
attack_flow.splash: Splash: half the main damage (floor) to every enemy adjacent to the target
attack_flow.stomp: Stomp units hit all adjacent enemies for floor(mainHit/2) per step moved, no retaliation
attack_flow.convert: Convert replaces damage: target changes owner, keeps HP/vet, can't act next turn; Bunny/Bunta unconvertible; counts as an attack
attack_flow.infiltrate: Cloak/Dinghy/Scuba adjacent to enemy city: steals that city's next income, deals base-attack damage to unit inside, spawns Daggers/Pirates = city level (cap 5); infiltrator is consumed

zone_of_control.v: entering a tile adjacent (8-neighbour) to a visible enemy unit forces a stop; Creep ignores ZoC; Hide units don't project it

movement.road_cost: 0.5 when both tiles are road/bridge/city/village AND neither is enemy territory
movement.terminal_tiles: Mountain and Forest (without road) end the move (Creep exempt)
movement.tech_gates: mountain: Climbing ; land->water via owned Port: Fishing ; Bridge on water: none ; ocean: Sailing (PE movement) vs Navigation (PE Explorer)
movement.embark: land unit stepping onto an OWN Port becomes Raft (Giant -> Juggernaut), keeps HP; disembark onto land restores type; both end the unit's turn
movement.water_units_on_land: may enter coastal land only, then must stop

income_per_turn.v: sum over own cities: (level + base + 1 if capital + 1 if workshop + parks + min(0,population)) + market income; besieged city = 0; infiltrated city loses only its normal income once

stars.turn_start: income is applied at the START of your turn (not on turn 0)
stars.siege: an enemy unit standing on the city centre tile

level_up.v: population >= level+1 ; then population -= level+1 ; level+=1 ; reward choice is mandatory
level_up.note: WK Score page consistent: 50 pts per level.

city.territory: capital/city claims radius 1 (3x3) on founding; Border Growth claims free tiles to radius 2
city.capture: unit must START the turn on the city tile; consumes the unit's turn; supported units lose their origin city
city.village_to_city: unit starting turn on village; consumes turn; becomes level-1 city (pop 0)

clear_forest.effect: forest->field, +1 star (PE); wiki Forestry page says +2 stars, undated - C19

burn_forest.src: 2025 balance pass dev post (PE had 5, stale)

road.effect: road on land/forest, own or neutral territory; wiki Roads page says 2, undated - C19

bridge.effect: bridge on shallow water between two land tiles (N-S or E-W)

Mine.note: PE header comment says 'Mine = 1' but code sets 2 (code trusted)

Market.income: stars/turn = sum of adjacent booster levels (cap 8)

buildings.booster_level: Forge = adjacent own Mines, Sawmill = adjacent Lumber Huts, Windmill = adjacent Farms (0..8)

monuments.AltarOfPeace: 5 consecutive turns with no attack + Meditation
monuments.build: cost 0, +3 pop, +400 score, one of each per player

score.city: 100 + 50 per level above 1 + 5 per current population
score.pe_caveat: PE ScoreSystem.startingScore() is stubbed to 0 (commented-out table disagrees with Tribe.cpp). Use tribes.json for starting scores.

ruins.action: unit must START its turn on the ruin; uses the unit's turn; ruin disappears
ruins.PE_reward_pool: uniform pick from the AVAILABLE pool: Stars(+10), Tech (random obtainable), Population(+3 to capital, if capital owned), Explorer (if hidden tile in 5x5), VeteranUnit (Swordsman 20HP vet, or Rammer 15HP on water)
ruins.note: Real probabilities unknown (G4). PE uses worldSeed+position hash, i.e. NOT the real RNG.

fog_vision.json._about: How reveal works (PE VisionSystem/MovementSystem/CitySystem) plus what that means for inference. WK Fog-of-War page was unreachable (client error) so these rules are PE-only unless marked.

geometry.v: square (Chebyshev) disk of radius r around the unit: all tiles with max(|dx|,|dy|)<=r

unit_vision.v: r = unit.visionRange (1 for most; 2 for Scout skill units: Cloak, Scuba, Scout boat, BabyDragon, FireDragon, IceFortress, Dinghy... ) ; a unit standing on a MOUNTAIN gets max(r,2)
unit_vision.note: WK Combat page: 'Mountains give a two-tile sight radius; Scout units see two tiles in every direction.'

persistence.v: reveal is permanent for the game (a per-player bit is set and never cleared).
persistence.note: PE only ADDS visibility. Whether the real game shows STALE or LIVE info for previously-seen-but-out-of-vision tiles is UNKNOWN (G3) - matters a lot for belief tracking.

movement_reveal.v: reveals along the whole traversed path (using the best vision seen during the move), plus final tile; mountain destination -> radius 2

must_end_on_visible_tile.v: a unit may only END its move on a tile that is revealed to its player

real_game_5x5.v: start score arithmetic needs 25 explored tiles (5x5 around capital); SC: capital near a corner scores 5 less because the corner tile isn't revealed

initial_reveal.PE: territory radius-1 (3x3) tiles revealed + the start unit's radius-1 vision; corners are skipped on Initial reveal

explorer.source: Level-2 city reward 'Explorer' (Luxidoor can't take it in capital) and ruin reward

algorithm.v: 15 steps. Each step: BFS (8-neighbour) dist<=4 over tiles the owner may enter (mountain needs Climbing, shallow water Sailing, ocean Navigation); score tile = 183 - 10*fog_tiles_cleared (plus-shape of 5 tiles, capped at 4) minus 33 if it clears a lighthouse; propagate +100 per BFS layer (3 layers); step to the best adjacent tile, -tie random, +5 penalty for stepping straight back; reveal a plus (centre+4 orthogonal) at every step
algorithm.note: A mirror site says 'up to 20 moves' (OLD, low). PE's 15 and wiki-derived scoring constants agree with each other.

explorer.tie_break_rng: seeded from turn, player, start position
explorer.reveals_ruin_area: ruin 'Explorer' reward only offered if some tile of the 5x5 around the ruin is still hidden

reward.v: first time a player reveals a corner: +1 population in capital (else best city)

lighthouses.monument: Eye of God after discovering all 4
lighthouses.fog_use: Corner tiles are KNOWN: land, no resource, no settlement (non-waterworld). Don't spend belief mass there.

tech_gated_visibility.note: Before the tech, those resources are not displayed. So 'no crop seen' without Organization carries NO information.

enemy_visibility.units_cities: visible only while inside current vision (playerIsCurrentlyVisibleTo checks live tiles)
enemy_visibility.hide_skill: Cloak/Dinghy/Scuba with Hide are invisible to others AFTER they have moved this turn (lastMoveDir != 0); then not targetable and don't project ZoC

retaliation_blind.v: defender cannot retaliate if it cannot see the attacker (WK). PE ignores this.

meeting_reward.v: first time you SEE any unit/city of tribe X: +stars = min(11, 1 + 2*ceil(score_of_X/1000))
meeting_reward.note: resolved at start of your turn and at end of an opponent's turn from live vision; non-Initial reveals trigger it immediately. Real values not verified.

fog_vision.json.player_visibility_state: PE stores a 16-bit mask per tile (bit i = player i has seen it).
inference_hooks: unseen tile ∈ {prior from map_generation} conditioned on: distance to nearest known settlement, tribe of nearest capital, shallow/deep water, tech gates
every known city/village excludes all unseen cells within Chebyshev<=2 for NEW villages (spacing >=3)
capital ring has >=2 identical resources (C10) -> sharp posterior for rival capital surroundings
map edge tiles never hold villages; corners are lighthouses
number of villages is bounded by (size//3)^2 - capitals, giving a total budget to allocate over unseen area

map_generation.json._about: Everything needed to simulate/estimate a freshly generated map. Square grid, Chebyshev distance, coordinates (x,y), index = y*size+x. Tile counts are size*size.

map_sizes.note: Perfection=normal 16x16; Domination: 1 opp tiny, 2 small, 3 normal, 4+ large. Tiny supports <=9 players, others <=16.

map_types.note: PE implements only 3 of the 6 wiki types; continents/pangea/archipelago pipelines are UNKNOWN (gap G1).

sector_grid.note: PE formula and wiki table agree exactly.

sector_assignment.v: players are assigned to a uniformly random permutation of the sector cells (extra sectors stay empty)

base_span.v: size // grid ; leftover = size - base_span*grid is distributed as origin offsets: origin(c)=c*base_span + min(leftover, max(1, min(leftover,c)-1))

eligible_cells.v: inner margin = 2 if base_span>4 else 1; x,y in [max(2,origin+margin), min(size-2, origin+span-margin)) ; wiki: capitals never within 2 tiles of a domain border

cell_weight.v: weight = max over ALL sector centres of max(1, base_span//2 - chebyshev(cell, centre))^3  (cubic pull towards a sector centre)
cell_weight.note: Wiki only says 'random within domain'. Cubic weighting is PE's reading of the reference generator.

capital_guarantees.v: capital tile = City + Road. The 4 orthogonal neighbours of every capital are forced to Land.

spacing.v: a village/suburb must be >2 (Chebyshev) from every city/village/capital, i.e. >=3 apart; never on map edge; <=1 per 3x3 area

map_types: lakes (PE) ; wiki: all except drylands & water world

suburbs.note: Suburbs are villages placed close to a capital: PE draws candidates in the 9x9 square around it. Wiki says 'all map types except Drylands and Water World' (so also continents etc.)

pre_terrain_count.v: floor((grid_slots - capitals - suburbs) * density) ; density lakes=0.30, waterworld=0.10, drylands=0.0
pre_terrain_count.note: Wiki: ~30% of theoretical max placed before terrain (10% water world, 0% drylands).

post_terrain_target.v: PE: tries grid_slots - capitals - pre_terrain villages, placing on LAND cells with x,y in [2,size-3] and >2 from every city; stops when no candidate. WIKI: 'about 60% after terrain' (80% drylands).
post_terrain_target.note: Real post-terrain village count is therefore uncertain. Empirically count villages in real games to fix this.

lakes.land_locked: capitals, suburbs, pre-terrain villages and the 4 neighbours of each capital are forced land
lakes.field: uniform random noise, locked-land cells = 1.0, outside the map counts as 1.0 (dry edges), 2 passes of 3x3 mean smoothing

water_fraction.v: water tiles = randint(ceil(0.25*N), floor(0.28*N)) lowest-field unlocked cells
water_fraction.note: 0.25/0.28 are PE's tuned constants ('kLakesMinWaterFraction' etc.), not wiki facts.

waterworld.note: Corners are NOT forced to land in water world (PE).

drylands.water: none, except 2 fish water tiles beside Kickoo/Aquarion capitals

shallow_vs_ocean.v: a water tile edge-adjacent (4-neighbour) to land/forest/mountain is 'shallow Water'; every other water tile is deep 'Ocean'. Diagonal-only contact = ocean.

corners.v: In non-waterworld maps the four corner tiles are forced Land with no resource/settlement; they are the 4 LIGHTHOUSE tiles.

method.v: each capital claims land by alternating 4-directional border growth in a freshly shuffled player order each round; each claim picks a uniformly random tile among the claimant's whole current frontier. Disconnected land goes to the nearest capital by Chebyshev distance.
method.note: Wiki: 'neighbouring tribes can influence capital terrain on 121-tile maps'.

base_shares.note: Enforced as exact shares since update 2.0.58 per wiki (PE draws i.i.d., so counts are only approximate).

modifier_rule.v: mountain = 0.14*mod_m ; forest_before = 0.38 + (0.14-mountain)*(0.38/0.86) ; forest = min(forest_before*mod_f, 1-mountain) ; field = remainder
modifier_rule.note: Wiki: mountains applied first (affect forest+field), forest next (affects only field).

area.v: resources appear only within Chebyshev distance 2 of ANY city/village/capital; 'inner' = distance 1 (the 8 tiles around it)

rates.note: NUMBERS agree between wiki and PE, INTERPRETATION does not. PE reads them as P(resource | terrain), e.g. P(fruit|field,inner)=0.18. The wiki rows sum to the terrain total (18+18+12=48), i.e. they are shares of ALL tiles, which implies P(fruit|field,inner)=0.375. Expected resources in the 8-tile inner ring: PE ~2.1, wiki reading ~5.3. Settle with C23 test before trusting either. Multiply by tribe modifiers (fruit, crops, animals, metal).

shallow.v: 0.50 * tribe_fish_mod, only inside the resource area

ocean.note: PE: 'public docs do not define a numeric ocean rate' - 0.10 is a tuned guess. Wiki says fish can appear in ocean inside borders.

fish.water_tile_tribe: water has no tribe; PE uses the nearest generated land biome's tribe for the fish modifier

resources.excluded: corner tiles and tiles that hold a settlement get no resource

capital_guarantee.WK_says: EVERY capital has >=2 identical resources within its ring: Xin-xi 2 metal, Oumaji 2 fruit, Hoodrick 2 animals; Bardur/Imperius/Kickoo/Zebasi/Elyrion/Cymanti tied to their start tech; all others 2 of a random tier-1 resource (fish, animal or fruit). Missing ones are force-spawned by replacing tiles.
capital_guarantee.use_for_fog: STRONG PRIOR: the 3x3 ring around an unseen enemy capital contains >=2 of the same resource; for most tribes the type is known.

tribe_modifiers._note: Missing key = 1.0. fish/animals/fruit/crops/metal multiply the resource rates; forest/mountain feed biome_assignment.modifier_rule.

Kickoo.note: WK also lists 2.0x water, but water mods are NOT applied by the game (WK).

Aquarion.note: WK: 1.5x water exists in code but has no effect.

Bardur.note: WK instead says '1.5x fruit, 0x crop'. Unresolved.

Luxidoor.note: WK table: base rate. (Luxidoor page: '++fruit, -game' - unquantified, ignored.)

Elyrion.note: PE has NO modifiers for Elyrion.

Polaris.note: WK: no own rates; land converts to Polaris terrain; mirror/mixed uses Imperius land.

Cymanti.note: PE has no modifiers for Cymanti.

count_by_tiles.note: Formula for other sizes: round(tiles*23/900). Wiki page gave no counts.

placement.v: random non-corner tile with no settlement; PE requires no settlement within Chebyshev 2

ruins.wiki_rule: WK: cannot spawn on shallow water, nor next to a village, city or another ruin.

starfish.placement: non-corner water tile with no resource and no settlement in its 3x3

reward_stars.note: collected when a unit enters the tile

starfish.wiki_flag: WK marks 'no adjacent starfish' as possibly incorrect

known_version_notes: 2.0.58 (Balance Pass 2): terrain percentages followed as exactly as possible.
Water rules pre-date Path of the Ocean update and may be outdated (WK).
Kickoo/Aquarion 'continents' 40%/30% water replacement is bugged and does nothing (WK).

modes.Domination: singleplayer, defeat all tribes in as few turns as possible; up to 10 opponents
modes.Glory: multiplayer; first to 10,000 points and hold the lead one turn

capital_income_per_turn.note: TOTAL starting capital income, not a bonus on top: wiki Game Modes says 'Normal 2 (same as humans)'. So Easy bots earn LESS than a human (C24).

bot_difficulty.aggression: higher ratings on higher difficulty (no numbers)
bot_difficulty.implication: bots win by income handicap, not by planning; their decision policy is undocumented. Needs black-box observation (replay logs).

PE.name: PolyEnv engine source (FryOne2137, MIT, C++, Jan-Feb 2026)
PE.note: A fan RE-IMPLEMENTATION written against the wiki. Good for exact constants and edge cases, but it is not the game's own code: it contains tuned values, stubs and deliberate deviations.

WK.note: Partly Discord-sourced; individual pages disagree with each other (see C1/C2). Map Generation page says domain behaviour verified in v2.0.49 and terrain % enforced since 2.0.58.

SC.note: Numbers are checkable by arithmetic (see validate_dataset.py), which raises trust.

DEV.name: Polytopia staff (Zoythrus) Steam comment on difficulty, ~2019

DER.name: Derived here by arithmetic from other facts

GA.note: README only retrieved; numeric tables (terrainProbs.json) NOT retrieved. Do not use for current numbers.

OLD.note: Pre-Moonrise or unverifiable. Used only as tie-breakers, never as primary.

tech_tree.json._about: 25 base techs. Prerequisites verified from PE TechDB and consistent with the wiki branch structure. A tier-2/3 tech needs ITS ONE prerequisite (not all lower tiers).

research_rule_2025.v: A tech is researchable if you own its prerequisite OR any tech it leads to ('backwards' research, e.g. Vengir Smithery -> Mining without Climbing).
research_rule_2025.note: PE may not implement this; matters for Vengir (Smithery) and Ai-Mo (Philosophy) starts. C25.

cost_formula.note: Wiki worked example (1 city): 5/6/7, with Literacy 4/4/5.

tech_tree.json.ruin_tech_rule: ruin 'Technology' reward picks uniformly among techs whose prerequisite you own (PE)

Climbing.unlocks: Mountain movement + mountain defence bonus (x1.5); reveals metal

Fishing.unlocks: Fishing action, Port, Raft (embark), water movement; reveals starfish (WK)

Meditation.unlocks: Mountain Temple; Pacifist task (Altar of Peace)

Aquatism.unlocks: Water Temple; defence bonus on water/ocean (x1.5)

Philosophy.unlocks: Mind Bender; Literacy (-33% tech cost); Genius task

Trade.unlocks: Market; Wealth task; (with 100 stars) Emperor's Tomb

special_tribe_trees._note: Special tribes REPLACE some techs. PE implements only the 25 base techs for every tribe, so these are NOT simulable with PE data.

tribes.json._about: Per-tribe start state + terrain modifiers (map_generation.json holds the modifier numbers). 'resolved' is MY best current belief given all evidence; 'PE'/'WK' are what each source says.

start_score_decomposition.constants: start: level-1 capital (100), territory 3x3 = 9 tiles (180), 5x5 = 25 explored tiles (125) -> 405 before unit/tech/level
start_score_decomposition.verified_by: validate_dataset.py reproduces 14 of the 15 wiki start scores exactly from components (all except Kickoo, C5); the PE start packages for Ai-Mo/Luxidoor/Kickoo do not (C1,C2,C5).
start_score_decomposition.corner_rule: SC: a capital whose 5x5 reveal contains a corner starts 5 points lower (corner tile not revealed).
start_score_decomposition.implication: The REAL initial reveal around a capital is 5x5 (25 tiles). PE reveals only the 3x3 territory + unit radius 1 (C21).

units.v: exactly one unit in the capital

capital_income.note: DEV: bot baseline +2 stars/turn from capital

resolved._note: Best current belief; confidence reflects agreement between sources AND the arithmetic score check.

AiMo.note: NamuWiki: 2025 patch changed Ai-Mo from Meditation to Philosophy + Hypnotist(Mind Bender), -33% tech cost. Fandom Ai-Mo/Tribes pages and the 615 score are pre-patch. 730 = 405+25+300 by formula; PE's own commented table also says 730.

Luxidoor.note: NamuWiki: Apr 2021 capital cut to level 2; Nov 2025 patch cut stars to 2 and RESTORED level 3. Fandom score 465 (level 2) is pre-Nov-2025. Level 3 = 515 by formula = PE. Wall: unconfirmed. Namu guaranteed-near-capital list: 2 fruit, 2 animal, 1 crop, 2 fish, 1 iron (8 tiles).

Polaris.note: 530 = 405+25(Mooni cost 5)+100(T1) by formula. Wiki Score page may be pre-2025; PE says 630. Unresolved - version drift possible.

Cymanti.note: 630 = 405+25(Shaman)+200(T2 Farming). NamuWiki also lists Farming (mushroom farming) and Shaman/Warrior ambiguity; PE has Shaman but no start tech.

Kickoo.note: Fishing+Warrior = 515 by formula and NamuWiki lists nothing else. The fandom score 615 is unexplained and possibly from an older version. Lean 515.

all units can move on water; land slow unless flooded
can build on water & place monuments on ocean
unique: Aqua Farm, Atoll, Flood/Fill, Tridention, Shark, Puffer, Jelly, Crab(super)

'at least 2 animals' guaranteed near capital (Strategies page)
Polaris: terraforming instead of boats; captured territory turns to Polaris terrain and water freezes
Ice Bank (income, max level raised 8->10 in 2019 nerf), Outpost gives 1 pop (was 2)
Cymanti: spores replace crops; >=2 spores guaranteed at start
Shaman boost: +0.5 attack, +1 move until it acts (WK Combat)
